mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant acceleration in unemployment (UNRATE) over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rise > 0.2pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with both PAYEMS declining and UNRATE rising.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annualized), overvaluation and policy tightening expectations cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5% annualized.
